newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia defense chief said new envoy to U.S..
newsitem.headline: Colombia defense chief said new envoy to U.S..

text.p: Defence Minister Juan Carlos Esguerra has been nominated by President Ernesto Samper to fill the vacant post of Colombia's ambassador to Washington, the influential weekly political magazine Semana said on Sunday.

The report, based on unnamed sources, said Esguerra's name had been submitted to U.S. authorities but it was unclear if or when it would be accepted. Neither the Colombian Foreign Ministry nor U.S. diplomats were available for comment.

Colombia has not had an ambassador in Washington since the resignation of Carlos Lleras de la Fuente in April, one month after the United States decertified Colombia as an ally in the drug war. Lleras blamed his resignation on allegations that Samper used drug money to finance his 1994 election camapign.
